articles.title: Global AI boom sees China’s chip exports nearly double in first half of year
articles.description: Exports of automatic data processing machines and parts jumped more than 41 per cent to top US$138 billion.
articles.content:
China’s chip exports nearly doubled in the first half of the year, customs data shows, as a global AI boom cemented computing hardware’s place as a key economic growth engine.
